items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Him and Marshall Royal were together up there -- that's the Eldorado Ballroom. And I played it.

ctx.x: Regal Theatre in Chicago was a very good friend of Lionel Hampton's. Lionel had called him -- well, see, Lionel had asked me in Houston to join his band, and I just got married during that time in the year of 1939, and he wanted to hear me play without a microphone, "Body and Soul" -- he said he heard about my big horn, as he said.

Him and Marshall Royal were together up there -- that's the Eldorado Ballroom. And I played it. And then he asked me to join the band, and well, I had heard from different musicians that he'd only get you out on the road and they would strand you there, and I was with like a family band where we all got along together, but if you ask any leaders for any money in advance, then you didn't get your job.
So I told him, I said, "Man, I have need $500 worth of debt -- if you can advance me $500, I'll pay my debt off and I'll be glad to come and join you." And I ain't heard no more from him.
